title: CompletedMatchingRingMapInjective
statement: Let A be a Noetherian commutative local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], U the open consisting exactly of the points other than its closed point, and C its maximal-ideal completion. Let q:Y\to U and s:E\to\operatorname{Spec} C be finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], and D an overlap identification [def-sbc-punctured-completion-matching-sections]. The canonical map B\otimes_A C\to\Gamma(E), with B the matching ring and map as in [def-sbc-completed-matching-ring-map], is injective.

source.place: Tags 0BLH, 05ER (the comparison, kernel and cokernel arguments), 05EU (algebra structure)

proof.text: Use the kernel-torsion lemma to obtain an exponent for a kernel element. Apply the torsion-kernel vanishing lemma with this exponent. The additive-homomorphism zero-kernel criterion gives injectivity.

proof_origin.place: Tag 05ER kernel argument, split into localization torsion and torsion injectivity
